name: b31-alone
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, a single sword lying alone and small in the frame on a wide empty dune, a straight double-edged early Arab sword (saif) of the 7th century: long straight iron blade with no curve, simple short iron crossguard, grip wrapped in dark leather, plain round pommel - not a curved scimitar; the wind blows thin streams of sand across the blade and is slowly burying it. Overcast pale sky, muted desaturated colours, vast empty space around it. Desolate, lonely, a sense of loss. No people, no hands, no faces, no blood, no moon, no text, no calligraphy, no modern objects.
